SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   C. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.

5. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.

6. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

8. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   D. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   D. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
